445	
446	> `sesh-*` requires `sesh` + `tmux`; `tsesh` also requires the `try-cli` Ruby gem. `mrun` / `tmrun` / `zjrun` only need tmux or zellij (whichever backend is selected) — no sesh dependency.
447	
448	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
449	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
450	| `sesh-sessions` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` | fzf popup picker for all sesh sessions (also bound to `Alt+S`) |
451	| `sesh-here` / `shere` | function / alias | `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` | Lightweight: bare shell session at `$PWD` (no nvim, no project layout). Pass args/`-c CMD` to override |
452	| `sesh-root` / `sroot` | function / alias | `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` | Connect sesh to current git root (falls back to `$PWD`); honors sesh.toml wildcards/default |
453	| `sesh-code` / `scode` | function / alias | `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` | Repo-scoped coding-agent layout: nvim 75% \| `specstory run [agent]` 25%, plus btop window. Session named `coding-agent/<repo>` (collision-safe). Refuses outside git repos. Flags: `--on-exit shell\|kill\|restart`, `--no-specstory` |
454	| `sesh-vibe` / `svibe` | function / alias | `dot_config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` | Parametric multi-agent layout: `svibe [N] [CLI]` (homogeneous) or `svibe --agents claude,codex,opencode,…` (heterogeneous). N tiled agent panes + lazygit window + nvim window. Session named `vibe/<repo>`. Same `--on-exit` / `--no-specstory` flags as scode |
455	| `try-sesh` / `tsesh` | function / alias | `dot_config/zsh/tools/32_try.zsh` | Open a `try` ephemeral workspace and immediately connect via sesh |
456	| `mrun` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/23_mrun.zsh` | Fire-and-forget: detached tmux/zellij session running CMD at `$PWD`, returns immediately. `mrun [-b tmux\|zellij] [-n NAME] [-d DIR] [-f] [--on-exit shell\|kill\|restart] [-k] [--] CMD [ARGS...]`. Default `--on-exit shell` keeps the session alive after CMD exits (drops to login shell, re-run via history-Up); `-k` restores fire-and-forget kill semantics. Backend default tmux (override via `$MRUN_BACKEND`). Soft-warns on TUI commands. Prints attach hint to stderr |
457	| `tmrun` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/23_mrun.zsh` | `mrun -b tmux`. Detached tmux session running CMD; attach with `tmux attach -t NAME` |

524	
525	### Proxy helpers
526	
527	> Portable loopback-proxy helpers. Honors `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` (+ optional `$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL` for split Clash `socks-port:` configs); otherwise prefers an active Clash config (`mixed-port:` or `port:`/`socks-port:` from `~/.config/clash/config.yaml` or `~/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yaml`) before falling back to probing ports 7890/7891/1087/8118/8080 with `nc -z -w1`. Detection is cached per shell; `proxy-off` and `proxy-refresh` clear that cache before the next lookup. Set `$LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1` to auto-export env vars on shell startup. Full guide: [docs/tools/web-reader.md](../tools/web-reader.md). See also: [docs/tools/containers.md](../tools/containers.md) for how `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` feeds the chezmoi-managed `~/.docker/config.json` `proxies.default` block.
528	
529	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
530	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
531	| `withproxy` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Run a single command with proxy env vars exported to the child only (e.g. `withproxy curl ...`) |
532	| `try_direct_then_proxy` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Run a command direct; on failure, retry via `withproxy`. Used as the default for reader functions. |
533	| `proxy-on` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Export `http_proxy`/`https_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY` in the current shell |
534	| `proxy-off` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Unset all proxy env vars in the current shell |
535	| `proxy-status` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Report state: **active** (exported), **available** (detected), or **unavailable** |
536	| `proxy-refresh` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Clear cached detection, re-probe, print status (use after toggling your proxy) |
537	
538	### Web reader
539	
540	> Render web pages as markdown in the terminal. All functions use `try_direct_then_proxy` so non-GFW'd URLs pay zero proxy overhead. Pick the extractor by function name. Full guide: [docs/tools/web-reader.md](../tools/web-reader.md).
541	
542	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |

589	> One-shot pipeline: capture a past block (via `cpblock N`) and pass it to a coding-agent CLI (claude / opencode / codex / cursor-agent) in non-interactive / advisory mode. Agent auto-detected in the order listed; override with `-a AGENT`. Prompt override via `-p PROMPT`. Agent reply goes to stdout (pipe-friendly: `aifix | tee /tmp/advice.md`), status line to stderr.

1	# AI-powered review of past commands — pipes the Nth block to a coding-agent
2	# CLI in one-shot / advisory mode (agent prints its reply; no file edits).
3	# Depends on 03_tmux_capture.zsh for `cpblock`.
4	#
5	#   aifix [N] [-a AGENT] [-p PROMPT] [--raw] [--no-meta]
6	#   aiexplain [N] [-a AGENT] [-p PROMPT] [--raw] [--no-meta]
7	#   aiblock                                                    # Python TUI
8	#
9	# Agent auto-detection order: claude → opencode → codex → cursor-agent.
10	# Override via -a AGENT. Advisory-only by design; there is no --execute flag.
11	# For a back-and-forth interactive session, use `aiblock` → "Spawn agent".
12	#
13	# Env-var defaults (set in ~/.zshrc or a 99_local_*.zsh to override):
14	#
15	#   AICAP_CLAUDE_MODEL     default: haiku           (claude --model alias)
16	#   AICAP_OPENCODE_MODEL   default: github-copilot/claude-haiku-4.5
17	#   AICAP_CODEX_MODEL      default: gpt-5-mini
18	#   AICAP_CURSOR_MODEL     default: (unset — let cursor-agent pick)
19	#   AICAP_SHOW_METADATA    default: 1  (tokens / cost / model on stderr)
20	#                                        only extracted from claude JSON output
21	#                                        for now; other agents print agent
22	#                                        name + model only.
23	#   AICAP_PRETTIFY         default: 1  (auto: glow → bat → raw; non-tty = raw)
24	#
25	# Defaults are set below; do not edit this file to change them — `export
26	# AICAP_*=…` in your shell rc instead.
27	
28	: "${AICAP_CLAUDE_MODEL:=haiku}"
29	: "${AICAP_OPENCODE_MODEL:=github-copilot/claude-haiku-4.5}"
30	: "${AICAP_CODEX_MODEL:=gpt-5-mini}"
31	: "${AICAP_CURSOR_MODEL:=}"
32	: "${AICAP_SHOW_METADATA:=1}"
33	: "${AICAP_PRETTIFY:=1}"
34	: "${AICAP_SPINNER:=1}"
35	
36	_aiagent_autodetect() {
37	  local cand
38	  for cand in claude opencode codex cursor-agent; do
39	    if command -v "$cand" &>/dev/null; then
40	      print -r -- "$cand"
41	      return 0
42	    fi
43	  done
44	  return 1
45	}
46	
47	# Background spinner on stderr while the agent is thinking. Skipped when
48	# AICAP_SPINNER=0 or stderr isn't a tty (so pipes / file redirects stay
49	# clean). The spinner subprocess is disowned via `&!` so it survives the
50	# command substitution that invokes the agent.

9	# codex / cursor-agent CLIs are authenticated.

11	# Env-var defaults (set in ~/.zshrc.adhoc or ~/.config/zsh/secrets.zsh to
12	# override; do not edit this file):
13	#
14	#   AISUGGEST_KEY              default: ^[;            (Alt+;)

20	#                                                       to $AISUGGEST_LOG;
21	#                                                       runtime-toggleable)

23	#
24	# Debugging:
25	#   `aisuggest "<text>"`              CLI form — same pipeline as the widget,
26	#                                     prints the suggestion to stdout.
27	#   `aisuggest --debug "<text>"`      Also prints raw / sanitized / final to
28	#                                     stderr layer-by-layer.
29	#   `export AISUGGEST_DEBUG=1`        Trace every widget step to $AISUGGEST_LOG.

35	#      shell out with `--no-session-persistence --effort low --no-chrome --tools ""

30	# Chezmoi
31	# https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/frequently-asked-questions/design/#why-does-chezmoi-cd-spawn-a-shell-instead-of-just-changing-directory
32	chezmoi-cd() {
33	  cd $(chezmoi source-path)
34	}
35	
36	# Git shortcuts
37	# NOTE: gcam (git commit --all --message) is provided by oh-my-zsh git plugin
38	# NOTE: gca (git commit --verbose --all) is provided by oh-my-zsh git plugin
39	# NOTE: gca! (git commit --verbose --all --amend) is provided by oh-my-zsh git plugin
40	# NOTE: gcan! (git commit --verbose --all --no-edit --amend) is provided by oh-my-zsh git plugin
41	
42	# Amend last commit message (pass new message as argument)
43	gcam-amend() {
44	  [[ -z "$1" ]] && { echo "Usage: gcam-amend <new message>"; return 1; }
45	  git commit --amend -m "$1"
46	}
47	
48	# Undo last commit → back to staged, print the undone commit message
49	gundo() {
50	  local msg
51	  msg="$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)" || return 1
52	  git reset --soft HEAD~1 && echo "Undone commit:\n  $msg"
53	}
54	# Show commits on current branch not yet pushed to origin/master
55	alias glop='git log --oneline origin/master..HEAD'
56	
57	# Zsh startup profiling
58	alias zsh-profile='ZSH_PROF=1 zsh -i -c exit'
59	
60	# Load NVM for current session (when needed for version switching)
61	alias load-nvm='export LOAD_NVM=1 && source "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" && source "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/bash_completion" && echo "nvm loaded: $(nvm current)"'
62	
63	# Regenerate cached bw completion (run after updating bw CLI)
64	alias bw-update-completion='mkdir -p "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh" && bw completion --shell zsh > "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zsh/bw_completion.zsh" 2>/dev/null && echo "bw completion cache updated"'
65	
66	# Install Ghostty terminfo on a remote host (unprivileged, into ~/.terminfo).
67	# Fixes character-rendering issues when SSH'ing into a fresh host from Ghostty/cmux/tmux.
68	# Usage: ghostty-ssh-terminfo <ssh-host>
69	ghostty-ssh-terminfo() {
70	  emulate -L zsh
71	  setopt pipefail
72	
73	  local host="$1"
74	
75	  if [[ -z "$host" ]]; then
76	    echo "Usage: ghostty-ssh-terminfo <ssh-host>" >&2
77	    return 1
78	  fi
79	
80	  if ! command -v infocmp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
81	    echo "ghostty-ssh-terminfo: local 'infocmp' not found" >&2
82	    return 1
83	  fi
84	
85	  if ! infocmp -x xterm-ghostty >/dev/null 2>&1; then
86	    echo "ghostty-ssh-terminfo: local terminfo 'xterm-ghostty' not found" >&2
87	    return 1
88	  fi
89	
90	  if ! infocmp -x xterm-ghostty \
91	      | ssh "$host" '
92	          set -e
93	          if ! command -v tic >/dev/null 2>&1; then
94	            echo "remote: tic not found" >&2
95	            exit 127
96	          fi
97	          mkdir -p "$HOME/.terminfo"
98	          TERMINFO="$HOME/.terminfo" tic -x -
99	        ' 2> >(grep -Fv "older tic versions may treat the description field as an alias" >&2); then
100	    echo "ghostty-ssh-terminfo: failed to install on $host" >&2
101	    return 1
102	  fi
103	
104	  echo "Installed xterm-ghostty terminfo on $host (in ~/.terminfo)"
105	}
106	
107	# Switch Homebrew mirror on-the-fly (GFW workaround). Updates env vars AND
108	# rewrites existing clone git remotes in-place, so a follow-up `brew update`
109	# uses the new mirror without reinstalling. Default baseline (Aliyun) is set
110	# in 00_exports.zsh.tmpl; use this only when a mirror misbehaves.
111	# Usage: brew-mirror                    # show current endpoints
112	#        brew-mirror {aliyun|ustc|bfsu|tuna}
113	brew-mirror() {
114	  emulate -L zsh
115	  local mirror="${1:-}"
116	  local api bottles brew_git core_git
117	  case "$mirror" in
118	    aliyun)
119	      api="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/homebrew-bottles/api"
120	      bottles="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/homebrew-bottles"
121	      brew_git="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/homebrew/brew.git"
122	      core_git="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
123	      ;;
124	    ustc)
125	      api="https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
126	      bottles="https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
127	      brew_git="https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/brew.git"
128	      core_git="https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/homebrew-core.git"
129	      ;;
130	    bfsu)
131	      api="https://mirrors.bfsu.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
132	      bottles="https://mirrors.bfsu.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
133	      brew_git="https://mirrors.bfsu.edu.cn/git/homebrew/brew.git"
134	      core_git="https://mirrors.bfsu.edu.cn/git/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
135	      ;;
136	    tuna)
137	      api="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles/api"
138	      bottles="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/homebrew-bottles"
139	      brew_git="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/brew.git"
140	      core_git="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/homebrew/homebrew-core.git"
141	      ;;
142	    "")
143	      echo "Current Homebrew mirror env vars:"
144	      echo "  HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN      = ${HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN:-<unset>}"
145	      echo "  HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN   = ${HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN:-<unset>}"
146	      echo "  HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE = ${HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE:-<unset>}"
147	      echo "  HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE = ${HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE:-<unset>}"
148	      echo
149	      echo "Usage: brew-mirror {aliyun|ustc|bfsu|tuna}"
150	      return 0
151	      ;;
152	    *)
153	      echo "brew-mirror: unknown mirror '$mirror'" >&2
154	      echo "Usage: brew-mirror {aliyun|ustc|bfsu|tuna}" >&2
155	      return 1
156	      ;;
157	  esac
158	
159	  export HOMEBREW_API_DOMAIN="$api"
160	  export HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN="$bottles"
161	  export HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE="$brew_git"
162	  export HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE="$core_git"
163	
164	  # Rewrite origin of existing clones. `brew --repo homebrew/core` only exists
165	  # if the user has tapped homebrew/core (optional in Homebrew 4.x — API/JSON
166	  # is default), so guard on .git presence.
167	  if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
168	    local brew_repo core_repo
169	    brew_repo="$(brew --repo 2>/dev/null)"
170	    [[ -n "$brew_repo" && -d "$brew_repo/.git" ]] && \
171	      git -C "$brew_repo" remote set-url origin "$brew_git" 2>/dev/null
172	    core_repo="$(brew --repo homebrew/core 2>/dev/null)"
173	    [[ -n "$core_repo" && -d "$core_repo/.git" ]] && \
174	      git -C "$core_repo" remote set-url origin "$core_git" 2>/dev/null
175	  fi
176	
177	  echo "brew-mirror: switched to $mirror"
178	  echo "  Run 'brew update' to re-sync indexes."
179	}
180
```

525	### Proxy helpers
526	
527	> Portable loopback-proxy helpers. Honors `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` (+ optional `$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL` for split Clash `socks-port:` configs); otherwise prefers an active Clash config (`mixed-port:` or `port:`/`socks-port:` from `~/.config/clash/config.yaml` or `~/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yaml`) before falling back to probing ports 7890/7891/1087/8118/8080 with `nc -z -w1`. Detection is cached per shell; `proxy-off` and `proxy-refresh` clear that cache before the next lookup. Set `$LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1` to auto-export env vars on shell startup. Full guide: [docs/tools/web-reader.md](../tools/web-reader.md). See also: [docs/tools/containers.md](../tools/containers.md) for how `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` feeds the chezmoi-managed `~/.docker/config.json` `proxies.default` block.
528	
529	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
530	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
531	| `withproxy` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Run a single command with proxy env vars exported to the child only (e.g. `withproxy curl ...`) |
532	| `try_direct_then_proxy` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Run a command direct; on failure, retry via `withproxy`. Used as the default for reader functions. |
533	| `proxy-on` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Export `http_proxy`/`https_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY` in the current shell |
534	| `proxy-off` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Unset all proxy env vars in the current shell |
535	| `proxy-status` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Report state: **active** (exported), **available** (detected), or **unavailable** |
536	| `proxy-refresh` | function | `dot_config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh` | Clear cached detection, re-probe, print status (use after toggling your proxy) |

589	> One-shot pipeline: capture a past block (via `cpblock N`) and pass it to a coding-agent CLI (claude / opencode / codex / cursor-agent) in non-interactive / advisory mode. Agent auto-detected in the order listed; override with `-a AGENT`. Prompt override via `-p PROMPT`. Agent reply goes to stdout (pipe-friendly: `aifix | tee /tmp/advice.md`), status line to stderr.

# Plan: `claude-plans-here` zsh function

## Context

Vibe coding 時 Claude Code 預設把 `/plan` 產生的計畫檔寫到 user-global 的 `plansDirectory`(例如 `~/.claude/projects/<repo>/plans/`),導致計畫散落在 home 而不是跟著 repo 走。

這個 repo 自己的 `.claude/settings.json` 已經示範了正確的做法 ——
\```json
{ "plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans" }
\```
讓 plan 檔留在當前 repo 的 `.claude/plans/`,可以跟 specstory transcripts、其它 agent 產物一起被 `agent-history-hygiene` skill 管理(redact + 入版控)。

需要一個 zsh function,在任何專案目錄一鍵把這份 settings.json scaffold 出來。對已存在的 settings.json(例如有 hooks / permissions / model 等其他 key),要 **jq 合併** 進 `plansDirectory` 而不是覆蓋,並且預設要互動確認。

## Approach

新增 zsh function `claude-plans-here` 到 `dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh` 結尾(緊接在 `brew-mirror` 之後),沿用同檔案既有的 `emulate -L zsh` + 短旗標 + stderr 提示風格。

### 行為規格

| 情境 | 行為 |
|------|------|
| `.claude/settings.json` 不存在 | 直接 `mkdir -p .claude` + heredoc 寫入兩行 JSON,**不需 jq、不 prompt** |
| 檔案存在,interactive | jq merge `plansDirectory: "./.claude/plans"` 進去前,`read -q` 問 y/N |
| 檔案存在 + `-f` | 跳過 prompt,直接 jq merge(non-interactive 用,例如腳本/CI) |
| 檔案存在但 jq 沒裝 | 印錯誤到 stderr,`return 1`(不 fallback,不靜默覆蓋) |

JSON merge 用 `jq '. + {plansDirectory: $p}'` —— 後者覆蓋前者語意,如果 key 已存在會被改寫成 `./.claude/plans`,其他 key 全部保留。寫入用 mktemp + mv 的兩步 atomic pattern,避免 jq 失敗時把原檔截斷。

### 命名

`claude-plans-here` —— 跟 `sesh-here`(在當前目錄起 sesh)、`brew-mirror`(切 brew mirror)、`gcam-amend`(amend last commit)同一個 dash-action 風格,`cl<TAB>` 也方便 tab-completion 把 claude-* 系列一起列出來。

## Files to modify

### 1. `dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh` —— 新增 function

加在檔尾(line 179 之後),約 30 行:

\```zsh
# Scaffold or update project-local .claude/settings.json so Claude Code's
# /plan files land in ./.claude/plans/ (kept inside the repo) instead of
# the user-global plansDirectory. Pairs well with the agent-history-hygiene
# skill, which can then redact + commit the plan files alongside the diff.
# Usage: claude-plans-here [-f]
#   -f   non-interactive: skip the y/N prompt when settings.json exists
claude-plans-here() {
  emulate -L zsh
  local force=0
  [[ "$1" == "-f" ]] && force=1
  local target=".claude/settings.json"

  mkdir -p .claude

  if [[ ! -e "$target" ]]; then
    cat >"$target" <<'EOF'
{
  "plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans"
}
EOF
    echo "Wrote $PWD/$target"
    return 0
  fi

  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "claude-plans-here: jq required to merge into existing $target" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  if (( ! force )); then
    local ans
    read -q "ans?$target exists. Merge plansDirectory into it? [y/N] " || { echo; return 1; }
    echo
  fi

  local tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp)" || return 1
  if jq --arg p "./.claude/plans" '. + {plansDirectory: $p}' "$target" >"$tmp"; then
    mv "$tmp" "$target"
    echo "Merged plansDirectory into $PWD/$target"
  else
    rm -f "$tmp"
    echo "claude-plans-here: jq failed; $target unchanged" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}
\```

關鍵設計點:
- `cat <<'EOF'`(quoted heredoc)— 確保 `$` 不被 shell 解釋,JSON 內容逐字寫入。
- jq path 用 `--arg p` —— 避免把字串當 jq 表達式 parse。
- `read -q` 是 zsh 內建單字元 y/N,符合 `emulate -L zsh` 環境。
- 不 pre-create `.claude/plans/` 目錄 —— Claude Code 第一次 `/plan` 時會自己建,少一個多餘動作。

### 2. `docs/zsh/aliases.md` —— 更新文件(repo 的 maintenance rule)

依照 `CLAUDE.md` 的 maintenance rule:任何 alias / function 變更要同步更新 `docs/zsh/aliases.md`。

- 在 TOC(line 10–26)插入新項:
  \```markdown
  - [Claude Code](#claude-code)
  \```
  位置:放在 `- [AI Capture]` 之後、`- [Package Managers & Runtime]` 之前。
- 在文件主體,於 "AI Capture" section(line 587–599)結束後、"Package Managers & Runtime"(line 602)之前,新增一個 section:

  \```markdown
  ---

  ## Claude Code

  > Project-local Claude Code config helpers. Requires `jq` only for the merge path.

  | Command | Type | Source File | Description |
  |---------|------|-------------|-------------|
  | `claude-plans-here [-f]` | function | `dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh` | Scaffold/update `./.claude/settings.json` so `/plan` files land in `./.claude/plans/` (in-repo) instead of the user-global plansDirectory. New file: write directly. Existing file: `jq`-merge the `plansDirectory` key (preserves hooks/permissions/model). Prompts `y/N` unless `-f` is given. |
  \```

## What is intentionally NOT changed

- 不動 `dot_claude/modify_settings.json` —— 那是 user-global `~/.claude/settings.json` 的 chezmoi `modify_` overlay,跟 per-project 的 `.claude/settings.json` 是兩個不同的 surface(參見 `CLAUDE.md` → "modify_ and create_ prefix semantics" 與 `docs/tools/agent-overlays.md`)。
- 不新建 tool-specific 檔案(例如 `dot_config/zsh/tools/06_claude_project.zsh`)—— 目前只有一個 function,沿用 `brew-mirror` 級別的精簡度放在 `10_aliases.zsh`,日後若再多兩三個 claude-* helper 再拆。
- 不在 function 裡 pre-create `.claude/plans/` 或 `.gitignore` 設定 —— Claude Code 自己會建目錄,gitignore 是 per-project 決策(有些人想 commit plan 檔)。

## Verification

1. **Reload shell**:`exec zsh`(或 `source ~/.config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh`)。
2. **空目錄建立**:
   \```bash
   mkdir /tmp/cph-test && cd /tmp/cph-test
   claude-plans-here
   cat .claude/settings.json   # 預期: {"plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans"}
   \```
3. **既有檔案 + interactive prompt**:
   \```bash
   echo '{"model":"opus","permissions":{"allow":["Bash"]}}' > .claude/settings.json
   claude-plans-here            # 應該 prompt: "...exists. Merge ... [y/N] "
   # 按 y → 預期合併後三個 key 都在
   jq . .claude/settings.json
   \```
4. **`-f` 非互動**:
   \```bash
   claude-plans-here -f         # 不 prompt,直接 merge
   \```
5. **jq 缺失情境**(可略,只有沒裝 jq 的 host 才需要):temporarily rename jq → 應該印錯誤、`return 1`、原檔不變。
6. **真實 Claude Code 流程**:在 step 2 的 `/tmp/cph-test/` 跑 `claude` 進入 plan mode,確認新生成的 plan 檔出現在 `./.claude/plans/<...>.md`,不是 `~/.claude/projects/...`。

New file: write directly. Existing file: `jq`-merge the `plansDirectory` key (preserves hooks/permissions/model). Prompts `y/N` unless `-f` is given |

 ## Package Managers & Runtime
 
 | Command | Type | Source File | Description |
diff --git a/dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh b/dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh
index c09f2b9..28dcfeb 100644
--- a/dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh
+++ b/dot_config/zsh/10_aliases.zsh
@@ -177,3 +177,50 @@ brew-mirror() {
   echo "brew-mirror: switched to $mirror"
   echo "  Run 'brew update' to re-sync indexes."
 }
+
+# Scaffold or update project-local .claude/settings.json so Claude Code's
+# /plan files land in ./.claude/plans/ (kept inside the repo) instead of the
+# user-global plansDirectory. Pairs well with the agent-history-hygiene skill,
+# which can then redact + commit the plan files alongside the diff.
+# Usage: claude-plans-here [-f]
+#   -f   non-interactive: skip the y/N prompt when settings.json exists
+claude-plans-here() {
+  emulate -L zsh
+  local force=0
+  [[ "$1" == "-f" ]] && force=1
+  local target=".claude/settings.json"
+
+  mkdir -p .claude
+
+  if [[ ! -e "$target" ]]; then
+    cat >"$target" <<'EOF'
+{
+  "plansDirectory": "./.claude/plans"
+}
+EOF
+    echo "Wrote $PWD/$target"
+    return 0
+  fi
+
+  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "claude-plans-here: jq required to merge into existing $target" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  if (( ! force )); then
+    local ans
+    read -q "ans?$target exists. Merge plansDirectory into it? [y/N] " || { echo; return 1; }
+    echo
+  fi
+
+  local tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp)" || return 1
+  if jq --arg p "./.claude/plans" '. + {plansDirectory: $p}' "$target" >"$tmp"; then
+    mv "$tmp" "$target"
+    echo "Merged plansDirectory into $PWD/$target"
+  else
+    rm -f "$tmp"
+    echo "claude-plans-here: jq failed; $target unchanged" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+}
```

 `/Users/daviddwlee84/.claude/plans/cli-tui-user-crystalline-key.md`

```text
1	# sleeper — A "look busy" TUI for macOS
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	工具用途：當你需要離開螢幕但不想被察覺 AFK 時，在螢幕上播放看起來很真實的「正在工作」畫面。同時防止螢幕鎖定/睡眠。如果有人靠近，可以一鍵把假裝編輯的檔案用真的 `$EDITOR` 開起來無縫接管。
6	
7	**實際行為**：
8	- 子程序跑 `caffeinate -dimsu` 防鎖屏，程式退出時自動殺掉
9	- 隨機在 fake-vim 介面打開使用者指定項目 (`--project ~/work/repo`) 的真實檔案，動畫式假打字
10	- 旁邊或切換出 fake-shell 跑「真的但無害」的 read-only 指令 (`ls`, `git status`, `git log`...)
11	- 旁邊或切換出 fake-AI chat 演示 debug/feature/refactor 對話（模板填入真實檔名/函式名）
12	- 熱鍵立即用 `$EDITOR` 打開當前顯示中的真實檔案，TUI 暫停、`$EDITOR` 退出後恢復
13	- 「panic key」：立刻切到最不顯眼的場景（shell 顯示 `git status`）再優雅退出
14	
15	**技術選擇**（已和使用者確認）：
16	- Go 1.22+ + Bubble Tea v1（單一 binary、Charm 生態做動畫最強）
17	- macOS only（caffeinate / iTerm2 + Terminal.app）
18	- 項目路徑透過 CLI flag 傳入，預設 `cwd`
19	- AI 對話用 `//go:embed` 內建模板 + 隨機填入真實 symbol，不呼叫外部 API
20	
21	## Architecture
22	
23	```
24	sleeper/
25	├─ cmd/sleeper/
26	│   └─ main.go              # cobra-style flags、signal handler、program.Run + panic recovery
27	├─ internal/
28	│   ├─ caffeinate/          # exec.Command 包裝，Setpgid=true，process-group kill
29	│   ├─ scanner/             # git ls-files -z 優先，filepath.Walk fallback；隱私黑名單
30	│   ├─ fakevim/             # bubbletea Model：status line、行號、chroma terminal256 高亮
31	│   ├─ fakeshell/           # bubbletea Model：viewport scrollback；安全指令 allowlist + 2s timeout
32	│   ├─ fakeai/              # bubbletea Model：chat bubbles；模板渲染器（embed FS）
33	│   ├─ scene/               # 上層 Model：lipgloss.JoinHorizontal 切版、tea.WindowSizeMsg 路由
34	│   └─ handover/            # tea.ExecProcess($EDITOR file) 暫停/恢復 TUI
35	├─ assets/
36	│   └─ ai_templates/        # *.tmpl debug/feature/refactor 對話腳本（embed）
37	├─ go.mod
38	└─ README.md
39	```
40
```

研究結果:Claude Code **沒有** 直接把 plan 檔跟 project 綁定 — `~/.claude/plans/` 是扁平全域目錄,檔名沒有編碼來源 cwd。

**但**有個間接信號可以利用:`~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/*.jsonl` 這些 session 對話檔會記錄當時 plan 寫到哪個路徑。Encoded path 規則是 `/` 和 `.` 都換成 `-`(例如 `/Volumes/Data/Program/tries/2026-04-28-sleep-helper` → `-Volumes-Data-Program-tries-2026-04-28-sleep-helper`)。

我驗證過:你的 `cli-tui-user-crystalline-key.md` 確實能在 `~/.claude/projects/-Volumes-Data-Program-tries-2026-04-28-sleep-helper/582ac0cc-...jsonl` 找到反向關聯。

## 設計

擴充 `claude-plans-here` 加上:

1. `mkdir -p .claude/plans`(不只 `.claude`)
2. 偵測階段(在 settings.json scaffold 之後):
   - 對 `$PWD` 和 `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`(兩者不同時兩個都檢查)做 path encode
   - 對應的 `~/.claude/projects/<encoded>/*.jsonl` grep 出 `~/.claude/plans/*.md` 的引用
   - 只列出**仍然在全域目錄**且**本地還沒有同名**的 plan
   - 列出後 prompt y/N,一次 copy 全部
3. `-f` 對兩個 prompt 都 yes-to-all(non-interactive 友善)
4. `cp -n` 防呆,不覆蓋本地既有

不刪除全域原檔(let user 自己事後清),`cp` 也不 mv。

## 變更摘要

`claude-plans-here` 升級為:

| Behavior | Detail |
|---|---|
| `mkdir -p` | 改成 `.claude/plans`(不只 `.claude`) |
| Orphan 偵測 | 對 `$PWD` 與 `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` 兩個 encoded path,掃 `~/.claude/projects/<enc>/*.jsonl`,只認 `"name":"(Write\|Edit)"` 的 tool_use 引用 — 排除單純被使用者/助手提到路徑的 false positive |
| Filter | 已存在於 `./.claude/plans/` 的略過 |
| Prompt | 列出後 y/N(預設 N) |
| Flags | `-f` = 設定 merge auto-yes;`-y` = orphan copy auto-yes;可組合 |
| 安全 | `cp -n` 不覆蓋,全域原檔不刪 |
